gloss: to judge, to handle, to deal with

definitions.explanation: To make a legal judgment on a case.
To manage or process things skillfully.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{仕事|しごと}を{裁|さば}く。
examples.english: To handle a large amount of work.

notes:
{裁|さば}く has two main uses: to judge legally and to handle/process things skillfully.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: Xを{裁|さば}く

LEGAL MEANING:
- {罪|つみ}を{裁|さば}く: to judge a crime
- {裁判|さいばん}で{裁|さば}く: to try in court
- {神|かみ}が{裁|さば}く: God judges

HANDLING MEANING:
- {仕事|しごと}を{裁|さば}く: to handle work efficiently
- {大量|たいりょう}の{注文|ちゅうもん}を{裁|さば}く: to process large orders

RELATED:
- {裁判|さいばん}: trial, court case
- {裁判官|さいばんかん}: judge
